description:
Activate Tymora's Invoker by paying {8}, causing you to draw two cards.
The Locust God triggers twice, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens with flying and haste and two 1/1 Squirrel creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar four times by sacrificing the Insects and Squirrels, adding eight {C}.
Repeat.
